id.description: Application ID; also the `aud` of its identity assertions.

public_hostname.description: Hostname users visit. Cannot be changed.

origin_url.description: HTTPS URL requests are forwarded to.

health_path.description: Path on the origin that verification probes.

status.description: `PENDING` until activated; `ACTIVE` serves traffic; `DISABLED` refuses it immediately.

revision.description: Increments each time the configuration is published to the Gateway.

client_id.description: OIDC client created for this application in the deployment's realm.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer of the deployment's realm.

callback_url.description: Redirect URI registered on the OIDC client, on the public hostname.

default.description: `authenticated` (any signed-in user, the default) or `deny` (only paths a rule matches).

rules.description: Every rule whose path prefix and methods match a request applies, and all of them must pass; deny wins. Prefixes match whole path segments, case-insensitively.

methods.description: Upper-case HTTP methods; all methods when omitted. GET covers HEAD.

effect.description: `require` (default): the conditions below must hold. `deny`: always refuse.

realm_roles_any.description: User must hold at least one of these realm roles.

client_roles_any.description: User must hold at least one of these roles on the app's client.

groups_any.description: User must be in at least one of these groups (full path).

claims_equal.description: Claims that must equal these values, e.g. `email_verified: true`.

header_mappings.description: Header name to claim, sent to the origin on every request.

assertion_enabled.description: Whether the signed identity assertion is sent.

jwks_url.description: Public keys that verify identity assertions.

post_logout_redirect_uri.description: Where users land after signing out, if not the Phase Two page.

origin_secret_header.description: Header that carries the origin secret: `X-Phasetwo-Origin-Secret`.

next_secret_pending.description: A rotated secret has been issued and not yet promoted.

verification.description: Latest verification of the current secret.

result.description: `VERIFIED` only when the valid secret got a 2xx and every other probe an explicit 401/403. `FAILED` when the origin admitted a request without the secret. `INCONCLUSIVE` otherwise (404, redirect, error, timeout).

status.description: HTTP status, or absent when the request failed.

next_verification.description: Latest verification of the pending (rotated) secret.

result.description: `VERIFIED` only when the valid secret got a 2xx and every other probe an explicit 401/403. `FAILED` when the origin admitted a request without the secret. `INCONCLUSIVE` otherwise (404, redirect, error, timeout).

status.description: HTTP status, or absent when the request failed.

readiness.description: Present on the single-app read; computed live.

auth_configured.description: The OIDC client exists and the realm's discovery matches its issuer.

origin_verified.description: The current secret's latest verification is VERIFIED.

hostname_ready.description: Cloudflare hostname and certificate are active, and DNS points to us.

dns_target.description: CNAME target the public hostname must point at.

validation_records.description: DNS records Cloudflare needs before it issues a certificate.

items.description: A single DNS record to create for domain validation.
items.title: DomainRecord
